raw_segments.text: I had coasted along the lower wall of the orchard, turned its angle.
There was a gate just there, opening into the meadow between two stone pillars crowned
From behind one pillar I could peep round quietly at the full front of the mansion.
I advanced my head with precaution, desirous to ascertain if any bedroom window blinds
Battlements, windows, long front, all from the sheltered station were at my command.
